# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Rapid EMA ribbon expansion indicates accelerating momentum across multiple timeframes, while a break above prior day high on strong volume signals institutional participation and follow-through buying. This combination captures continuation momentum in trending markets where retail participation drives initial breakouts and institutions add on retests of prior session extremes.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At 3-min bar close when:
- Ribbon width change [(current width - width 5 bars ago) / width 5 bars ago] > 0.30
- Price > prior day high
- Volume > 2 * average volume of prior 5 bars

**Exit:** 
- Initial stop: prior day low (structure stop)
- TP1: 2R (risk-reward) from entry
- Runner: Chandelier trail using ATR(3)*2 below highest high since entry
- Time exit: 15:50 ET if not stopped out earlier
